purpose: Driver fix: Nord2Metal.bundle/Nord2Metal replaced by y2s37-ycbcr = the installed y2s36-planar objects with redwoodmetal.m changed (and gpu/y2s/nord2_ycbcr.c added): a texture of MTLPixelFormatYCBCR8_420_2P (500) over a '420f'/'420v' IOSurface is served as a BGRA texture converted from the two planes on the CPU whenever the surface changes (matrix as CoreAnimation reads it from IOSurfaceGetYCbCrMatrix, BT.601 by default; range from the FourCC). QuartzCore draws a format-500 texture with its ordinary image shader and expects RGB from it; the Mali samples Y,Cb,Cr raw (run q10hd-planar: white bars pink, black bars teal). libredwoodair.dylib is NOT changed. Previous executable kept as /private/var/db/nord2-metal/Nord2Metal.pre-ycbcr; receipt.json inventory updated (Nord2Metal hash). Undo: guest-ycbcr-undo.sh (back to y2s36-planar).
